name: CardioMag
full_name: CardioMag eMNS with magnetic catheter and magnetic localisation (ETH)
versions: single (RA-L 2022); same eMNS platform as Navion's academic origin; 2017-19: ETH (Nelson) magnetic catheters in Aeon Phocus: tethered magnet catheter with force and 5-DOF pose control (Chautems 2017 ICRA) and variable-stiffness 2- and 3-segment catheters (Chautems 2017 IROS; 2019 Adv. Intell. Syst.) (Hwang 2020 Figs. 8a, 8g) (hwang2020_review)
target_anatomy: endoluminal, 2D vascular models (24 mm and 11 mm channels)
devices_driven: own catheter: OD 2.8 mm / ID 2 mm Flexan tube with 3 mm OD x 6 mm permanent magnet at tip, Hall sensor 12 mm behind magnet
n_dof_detail: field direction and gradient from 8 electromagnets; advance by Maxon-motor catheter advancer at 10 mm/s
footprint_mm: eMNS about 0.3 m scale bar in Fig. 1 (size N.R. in text)
force_sensing: Hall-effect sensor for localisation (range +/- 36 mT per axis), no force sensing
imaging_compat: localisation from magnetic field; fluoroscopy minimised; overhead camera as ground truth
validation_detail: 2D vascular models a and b; catheter navigated through all branches; localisation tested over 40 trials on path 1-3 of model a
key_numbers: eMNS fields 20 mT, gradient 0.15 mT/mm; mean localisation error 3.64 mm (sd 1.61) model b, 2.74 mm with extra field change; model a mean 7.94 mm (sd 2.94), 5.65 mm with extra gradient; position estimate 38.3 ms
sim_model: linear model of the eMNS (coil currents to field), calibrated; no physics simulator of the catheter
